Galxe, a major Web3 quest and rewards platform, announced it will wind down its core services, including Galxe Quest, Galxe ID and Galxe Passport, as it shifts its team and brand to its Layer 1 blockchain, Gravity. Over more than five years, Galxe has served 36 million users and over 7,700 partner projects. New campaigns have been suspended, with participation ending December 5 and reward claims closing December 15, after which the website will become read-only. Gravity will continue operating, and the G token will remain unaffected. — link
